reply_text:
I've replied to Hollis in the DM: on Oct 14 they told me their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups is **Gate 40** from then on.

I took this from Hollis's own DM with me, so it's information they can already see.

I couldn't search gbrain first as the setup asks. It refused the search and read nothing, because its access token isn't tied to any member. Fixing that needs someone with access to the machine that runs gbrain. They'd run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<MEMBER>'`, or set it up to act for several named members. Until then, searches through gbrain will keep failing. That didn't change this answer.
